capabilities: Insert citations through [@ citekey completion backed by a local Better BibTeX index
Import literature notes and PDF annotations into managed, previewed note sections
Show references and annotations sidebars with CSL bibliographies for the active note
Write CSL-JSON bibliography sidecars and Word export kits for pandoc
Query the citation index through an agent CLI and paper-ingest service
extras: Desktop only; mobile not supported. Templates from Zotero Integration or ZotLit are not interchangeable. Ships an agent CLI, a migration helper from its predecessor cmds-link-zotero, detailed privacy disclosures, and a user guide in English and Korean.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to connect a local Zotero library's citations, annotations, and reading history into vault notes.

relations.evidence: Verified Zotero sources, citations, annotations, and literature notes for a local-first research vault.
Cite As You Write citation insertion through Better BibTeX (BBT).
Copyable Markdown links for Hookmark (Zotero item, Obsidian file, rename-safe identity link)
Run pandoc after export runs pandoc --defaults <kit>/defaults.yaml in the kit folder
an obsidian://advanced-uri?…&filepath=… row when the peer vault's community plugin list includes Advanced URI
For an existing cmds-link-zotero installation, use the explicit, reversible helper.
This is not full Zotero Integration or ZotLit compatibility.

summary: Zotero integration that imports literature notes and PDF annotations, completes citekeys, renders CSL bibliographies, and exports to Word via pandoc.
